blender.name: Instant camera, crystal-ball stand & magic wand
blender.detail: the pastel instant camera that prints the last-moment photo, the walnut stand of the crystal ball and the wand

original: Made for this project: the painted twilight sky (gradient, sunset glow and stars — no HDRI), toon shading with ink outlines, the floating storybook text, the gingham tablecloth, candles and flames, letter, envelope and wax seal, balloons, the glowing crystal ball and the stars that write a name in the sky, wish jar, month calendar, polaroids and the instant-film developing effect, cassette label, string lights, meadow grass and flowers, fireflies, wind system, fireworks, confetti and all synthesised sound effects.
